verses.text: Yahweh told Moses, ‘Go to Pharaoh and tell him: “This is what Yahweh, God of the Hebrews, says: Let my people go worship me. 📣
“‘If you keep refusing and hold them back, ⚠️
“‘Yahweh’s hand will bring a terrible disease on your livestock out in the fields—your horses, donkeys, camels, cattle, and sheep. 🐄
“‘Yahweh will treat Israel’s livestock differently from Egypt’s. Not one animal belonging to Israel will die.”’ 🛡️
Yahweh set the time and said, ‘Tomorrow I’ll do this in the land.’ 🗓️
The next day Yahweh did it. All Egypt’s livestock died, but not one animal belonging to Israel died. 🐄
Pharaoh sent someone to check, and not one Israelite animal had died. But Pharaoh stayed stubborn and wouldn’t let the people go. 👑
Yahweh told Moses and Aaron, ‘Take handfuls of soot from a furnace. Moses must toss it into the air in front of Pharaoh. 🔥
‘It’ll become fine dust over all Egypt, causing painful boils and sores on people and animals throughout the land.’ 😷
They took furnace soot and stood before Pharaoh. Moses tossed it into the air, and painful boils and sores broke out on people and animals. 😷
The magicians couldn’t even stand in front of Moses because of the boils; the sores were on them and all the Egyptians. 😣
But Yahweh made Pharaoh stubborn, and Pharaoh wouldn’t listen, just as Yahweh had told Moses. ⚠️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Get up early tomorrow and stand before Pharaoh. Tell him: “This is what Yahweh, God of the Hebrews, says: Let my people go worship me. 🌅
“‘This time I’m sending all my plagues against you, your officials, and your people, so you’ll know no one in the whole world is like me. 🌍
“‘By now I could have reached out, struck you and your people with disease, and wiped you off the earth. ⚠️
“‘But I’ve kept you standing for this reason: to show you my power and make my name known throughout the whole world. 📣
“‘Yet you still set yourself against my people and refuse to let them go. 😠
“‘Tomorrow around this time I’ll send such a terrible hailstorm that Egypt has never seen anything like it—not since it became a nation. 🌩️
“‘So now, get your livestock and everything you own out in the fields under shelter. Any person or animal left outside will be hit by the hail and die.”’ 🏠
Some of Pharaoh’s officials respected Yahweh’s warning. They rushed their servants and livestock indoors. 🏃
But whoever didn’t take Yahweh’s warning seriously left their servants and livestock out in the fields. ⚠️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Reach your hand toward the sky, and hail will fall on every person, animal, and plant throughout Egypt.’ 🌩️
Moses raised his staff toward the sky. Yahweh sent thunder and hail, and lightning flashed down to the earth. Hail poured over Egypt. 🌩️
It was the worst hailstorm Egypt had ever seen since it became a nation, with lightning flashing through the storm. ⛈️
The hail struck everything in the fields—people, animals, plants, and trees—and shattered every tree out there. 🌳
But there was no hail in Goshen, where the Israelites lived. 🛡️
Pharaoh sent for Moses and Aaron and told them, ‘This time I’ve sinned. Yahweh is right; my people and I are in the wrong. 🙏
‘Pray to Yahweh. We’ve had enough thunder and hail! I’ll let you go; you don’t have to stay any longer.’ ⛈️
Moses said, ‘As soon as I leave the city, I’ll spread my hands out to Yahweh. The thunder will stop, and there won’t be any more hail. Then you’ll know the earth belongs to Yahweh. 🙏
‘But I know that you and your officials still don’t truly respect Yahweh God.’ 😔
The hail ruined the flax and barley, because the barley had formed heads and the flax was flowering. 🌾
But the wheat and spelt weren’t ruined because they hadn’t grown yet. 🌱
Moses left Pharaoh’s city and spread his hands out to Yahweh. The thunder and hail stopped, and the rain quit falling on the ground. 🌧️
When Pharaoh saw the rain, hail, and thunder had stopped, he sinned again. He and his officials became stubborn all over again. 😠
Pharaoh stayed stubborn and wouldn’t let the Israelites go, just as Yahweh had said through Moses. ⚠️
